title: Poland Summons Israeli Ambassador Over Discontinued World Central Kitchen Probe
detail: Poland's Foreign Ministry summoned Israel's ambassador on August 21, 2026 to express its 'great disappointment' after being informed on August 19 that the IDF had discontinued its investigation into the April 2024 strike on a World Central Kitchen aid convoy that killed seven humanitarian workers, including Polish volunteer Damian Sobol. The UK, Canada and Australia — whose citizens were also killed in the strike — issued a joint statement calling the IDF's decision to close the case without charges 'shameful' and another example of the lack of accountability for incidents in Gaza. World Central Kitchen condemned the IDF's findings as 'inconsistent with the full truth and deeply offensive.'

title: IDF Shoots Palestinian Who Crossed Into IDF-Controlled Area of Southern Gaza
detail: The Israeli military said on August 21, 2026 that troops operating in southern Gaza shot a Palestinian who crossed into the IDF-controlled area beyond the Yellow Line and approached soldiers 'in a way that posed an immediate threat.' The incident was reported as the latest in a string of shootings the IDF has classified as ceasefire enforcement against individuals crossing the demarcation line, amid continued friction over the stalled Gaza roadmap. Separately, Turkey, Egypt and Qatar jointly condemned the recent wave of Israeli strikes in Gaza, urging Israel to meet its ceasefire obligations.

media.caption: IDF says troops shot a Palestinian who crossed into the IDF-controlled area of southern Gaza
